_about: THE PLACEMENT OF ENTRY B's PIECES (T573): one record per excluded item of a DFO row (pipeline.regs.dfo_salmon.closures.PieceGeometry) — a stretch between two cuts or a circle (centre + radius). PROPOSALS for the owner; nothing in the places files, the atlas or the feed reads this. Joined to the LIVE row by item key (closures.attach): a piece whose item DFO drops stays here, marked not live by the reader.

pieces.name: Deadman
pieces.item: Deadman - from the fishing boundary signs approximately 1 km downstream of the Hwy No. 1 Bridge at Savona to the CN rail bridge approximately 500 m downstream of the confluence with Deadman Creek.

pieces.name: Pendleton Creek
pieces.centre_from: BC Geographic Names has Pendleton Bay on Babine Lake (name id 6951) and a Pendleton Creek with no point at the lake; the network has no stream of that name. Proposed: the largest UNNAMED stream meeting the shore within 1500 m of that point (FWA blue line 360807538, order 3, 590 m from it; 3 segments meet the shore there)

looked.6:babine-lake#379a9388f532: no stream named Six Mile / Sixmile Creek in the FWA network within 6 km of the lake, and no BC Geographic Names creek of that name at the lake. By local accounts it is near Four Mile Creek at the lake's east end: three unnamed streams meet the shore within 2 km of Four Mile's mouth, none provably it
looked.6:babine-lake#963a5557f71b: no stream named Hazelwood (or Heazlewood) Creek in the FWA network within 6 km of the lake; BC Geographic Names' only Heazlewood Creek is not at Babine Lake
looked.6:babine-lake#6b5f946bc1eb: no stream named Sockeye Creek in the FWA network within 6 km of the lake; BC Geographic Names' Sockeye Creeks are not at Babine Lake

3:thompson-river#5adc77c1f78d.label: 4 km above the lower signs
3:thompson-river#5adc77c1f78d.why: DFO: “downstream approximately 4 km to the fishing boundary signs located at 50°46.893' N and 121°08.110' W” — 4,000 m up the river from DFO's own coordinate (the closed area is then 4.0 km)

3:thompson-river#5adc77c1f78d.label: 1.5 km below Juniper Beach Park
3:thompson-river#5adc77c1f78d.why: DFO: “approximately 1.5 km downstream from Juniper Beach Park” — 1,500 m below the park's downstream boundary is 37 m from the existing cut at Battle Creek's confluence, so that existing cut is proposed (the closed area is then 1.2 km, not “approximately 4 km”)
